# TanStack Devtools: one unified debugging panel for your TanStack apps

Curated by Skill Harbor — @tanstack-skills's skill for the TanStack Devtools panel: a unified, extensible debugging interface that consolidates devtools for TanStack Query, Router and other libraries into one panel, built with Solid.js for lightweight performance. It covers basic setup (npm install @tanstack/react-devtools, mount <TanStackDevtools/> inside the QueryClientProvider), the built-in plugins (Query — ReactQueryDevtoolsPanel; Router — TanStackRouterDevtoolsPanel with the router instance; AI — AIDevtoolsPanel for AI workflows: message inspector, token usage and cost tracking, streaming visualization, tool-call debugging, reasoning-token viewer, adapter switching), the plugin system (the DevtoolsPlugin interface — id, name, render — with custom-plugin and dynamic-registration recipes like a state inspector or network logger), the Vite plugin integration, production considerations (conditionally include in development only, or lazy-load), framework support (React alpha; Solid, Vue, Angular planned), and best practices plus common pitfalls (unique plugin IDs, lightweight render functions, don't ship devtools to production without tree-shaking). Honest caveats: alpha status — expect API churn; the skill is documentation the agent reads, not an auto-installer — you add the npm packages to your app yourself; devtools belong in development builds only. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
